infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Challenge Fit needs background location to suppress mission alerts while you are already exercising.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Challenge Fit needs location to track your activity.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Challenge Fit uses motion data to detect when you are stationary for long periods.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Challenge Fit needs to read your activity data to automatically validate missions if you were active during their time window.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Challenge Fit uses your activity data to help you complete fitness missions automatically.
